races.paceDynamic: The Liffey, Dontspoilasale, Thaloria, and Suerte all want prominent positions creating early congestion and a falsely-run race. With no genuine front-runner, the pace will be moderate early before quickening significantly in the final 2f. The four hold-up horses (Benavente, Una Matata, Ruff Justice, Crest Of Light) will benefit from the sprint finish if they can get clear running.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If The Liffey and Dontspoilasale avoid early traffic and secure clean forward positions
scenarios.body: The superior class of these two shines through as they control the race from the front. Thaloria and Suerte get outpaced when the tempo lifts approaching the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet create a messy pace and the race becomes a cavalry charge
scenarios.body: Una Matata and Benavente get the strongest finish from the back as the early leaders tire. The moderate early gallop sets up perfectly for the closers with racing room.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses interfere with each other 2f out creating gaps for patient rides
scenarios.body: Crest Of Light finds the clearest passage from the rear as the fancied horses get hampered. Ruff Justice also benefits from a clean run while others struggle for room.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Going Concerns Materialize
scenarios.trigger: If Benavente, Ruff Justice, and Thaloria all underperform due to the good ground conditions
scenarios.body: The going-dependent horses fail to fire leaving a smaller effective field. Una Matata capitalizes from the reduced competition while The Liffey dominates from the front.
